---
name: Pattern Request
about: Request a new masking pattern or report a pattern that isn't matching correctly
title: "[Pattern] "
labels: pattern
assignees: ''
---

## Pattern type

- [ ] New pattern (not currently detected)
- [ ] Existing pattern not matching correctly
- [ ] False positive (non-sensitive data being masked)

## Description

What sensitive data should be masked (or is being incorrectly masked)?

## Examples

Provide example values that should match (use fake/sample data, not real secrets):

```text
example-value-here
```

## Category

Which category does this belong to? (Azure, AWS, GCP, OpenAI, Anthropic, General, or new category)

## Additional context

- What site(s) does this appear on?
- Is the data in regular text, an input field, or both?
